finding.text: The in-flight page is not shown in the shots: `/framework/ai/now/` renders the AI board with its "Now" card (shots/monorepo-localhost-framework-ai-now/sheet.png, all four widths), not the `AINow` view. Either the new child loses to the AI board's own `now` route or the dev server was not restarted. "Right at 400 px" is unproven (Requirements 2).

No before/after shot of the sessions grid, and no `check.mjs` or in-flight vs `list_agents` numbers are in the diff (Requirements 3). The plan note admits the count deviates by design (5-minute "working" vs Servex working), so the equality proof was not made.

`Server/SessionIndex.mjs` (the `tasks` source) is not in the diff, so the "one index feeds the grid" ask for `tasks` is not visibly met (Requirements 1). The diff only imports it, and the readme still describes it as a second source.
A `layout.json` of `/ai/now/` at 400 shows 67 items, `empty 0.506` and a 13727 px band. These are the board's numbers, not the new page's.
